action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull changes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restore AssetHealthService
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("mv /opt/areloria/server/src/assets/AssetHealthService.ts.bak /opt/areloria/server/src/assets/AssetHealthService.ts 2>&1")
print("Restore:", stdout.read().decode())

# Try build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria")
print("\nRestart")

time.sleep(10)

# Check ports
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep -E 'node|8080'")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
